faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about partnering with Hybrid.
faq.documentsQ: What documents do I need to register?
faq.documentsA: You'll need your business license, FSSAI certificate (for restaurants), GST registration, and valid ID proof.
faq.onboardingTimeQ: How long does the onboarding process take?
faq.onboardingTimeA: Most partners go live within 24-48 hours after submitting all required documents.
faq.commissionA: Our commission structure starts at 15% and varies based on location, service type, and volume. Contact our team for a personalized quote.
faq.multiServiceQ: Can I offer both food delivery and ride services?
faq.multiServiceA: Absolutely! Many of our partners operate multiple services. We provide a unified dashboard to manage everything.
faq.commitmentQ: Is there a minimum commitment period?
faq.commitmentA: No long-term contracts. We believe in earning your partnership every day with transparent terms.

onboarding.contractIntro: This Partner Merchant Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between the merchant ("Partner") and HYBRID Technologies Inc. ("Platform").
onboarding.contractClause1Body: The Platform agrees to list the Partner's {{value}} and facilitate {{service}} to end customers through the HYBRID platform.
onboarding.contractClause2Body: Partner agrees to pay a commission on each order as per the agreed commission structure. Commission rates are subject to review and modification with 30 days' notice.
onboarding.contractClause3Body: All payments due to Partner will be settled on a weekly basis, net of commissions, fees, and applicable taxes. Partner is responsible for providing accurate bank account details.
onboarding.contractClause4Body: Partner retains the right to set prices. The Platform may suggest pricing optimization. Partner must maintain accurate listings and availability.
onboarding.contractClause5Body: Partner agrees to maintain quality, hygiene standards, and packaging requirements as specified by the Platform. Non-compliance may result in de-listing.
onboarding.contractClause6Body: This agreement shall remain in effect until terminated by either party with 30 days' written notice. The Platform reserves the right to terminate immediately for breach of terms.
onboarding.contractClause7Body: Partner agrees to the collection and use of customer order data for analytics and platform improvement purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
onboarding.contractClause8Body: Partner agrees to indemnify and hold the Platform harmless from any claims arising from the quality or safety of products, delivery delays, or any breach of applicable laws.
onboarding.contractAcknowledgement: By accepting this agreement, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all the terms and conditions outlined above.
